_comment: 'Stand aside' (hub option 1) is the ONLY currently-reachable nonviolent goblin-encounter resolution in this content -- its sole producer of `goblins_spared`. Any future nonviolent goblin resolution (a second parley instance, a post-fight spare option) must ALSO bank `goblins_spared` or the counter under-counts silently -- it feeds the Garden K-of-4 gate and the memorial hill's goblin plot, both absent-as-zero reads with no other producer today.

hub.speaker: Goblin Warband
hub.text: The goblins fan out across the road, blades low. One eyes your gear, weighing something.

options.text: Stand aside. I've killed things bigger than your whole warband. (Warrior)

backdown.speaker: Goblin Warband
backdown.text: A long pause. The lead goblin sniffs, spits, and waves the others off the road. They keep their eyes on you until the corner.
